findings.one_line: The promised total honest profile interval with all-strength minimax attainment is still an explicit open obligation; the delivered kernel is a computable lower frontier plus grid-aligned calibration, not the headline upper/attainment result.

Position the lower-frontier theorem against accepted-bank stat_transported_late_strength_frontier_v1: explain precisely why its matched weak-LATE length frontier and score-inversion attainment do not cover the unknown-cutoff Hölder profile, and what theorem-level increment the two-envelope converse adds.
